name: Historic Town of Guanajuato and Adjacent Mines
description: Tucked into a narrow valley in central Mexico, Guanajuato is a colonial silver town of winding alleys, steep stairways and streets that run through underground tunnels. Its wealth came from nearby mines, once among the richest in the world, and paid for the pink and green sandstone mansions and the Baroque churches of La Compañía and La Valenciana. The mines still include a shaft plunging 600 metres.
